scripts.dev: npm run clean  && npm run prebuild && tsx watch --env-file=.env server.ts
scripts.start: npm run build && node --env-file=.env -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); " && cd dist && node --env-file=.env server.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsx build.ts && cp -R data dist/data && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -iname '*.pem' -o -iname 'keystore.json' -o -iname '.env' \) -exec cp {} dist/ \;
